mapper.select: select orders.PS as drcrflag, b.BUSI_ACCT_NO as outacctno, '0' as intertranflag, b.ACCT_NAME as fromacctname, b.LARGE_PAYNO as outbranchno, c.ACCT_NAME as inactname, c.LARGE_PAYNO as inbranceno, c.BUSI_ACCT_NO as inacctno, orders.SETTLE_AMT as amt, orders.CCY as ccy, case orders.CCY when #{ccycode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 'N' else '1' as cattflag, 'CTR' as outacctusage, '' as remark2, 'CTR' as inacctusage from STL_PAY_ORDERS orders left join (select capacct.BUSI_ACCT_NO, capacct.ACCT_NAME, capacct.LARGE_PAYNO from STL_CAPACCT_INFO capacct where capcct.ACCT_NO = orders.MY_ACCT_NO ) b left join (select capacct.BUSI_ACCT_NO, capacct.ACCT_NAME, capacct.LARGE_PAYNO from STL_CAPACCT_INFO capacct where capcct.ACCT_NO = orders.COUNTER_ACCT_NO ) c where orders.ORDER_ID = #{orderid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
